purpose: Close the hidden-fleet-in-being posture behind the Marshalls so carrier GO/withhold decisions use real transit, range and mission-state constraints rather than assuming the first-line carriers are either at Truk or magically in strike position.
authority_note: No CURRENT promotion. Exact escort hull roster remains unclosed until a surface/carrier engagement requires hull-level accounting.

core.Soryu: Excluded from the mobile striking core; still in the late-Jan/early-Feb trial and team-readiness return clock.
core.air_group_guard: Ready-aircraft class includes fighter/attack/recon reservations and is not a simultaneous strike count. Experienced strike-leader/navigation debt from GALVANIC remains.
core.Kinsei_fighter_note: Kinsei-Zero concentration remains preferential on Shokaku/Zuikaku with a mixed Hiryu group; exact Jan-31 subtype count is intentionally not re-audited here and may not be used to inflate strike radius.

screen_and_logistics.fast_surface_screen: Pacific fast-battleship/cruiser/destroyer screen and oilers are allocated as a real opportunity cost; exact named roster deferred pending combat need.
screen_and_logistics.Indian_Ocean_guard: Oyodo + four-DD western release and the already-realized Indian-Ocean submarine layer are not clawed back.
screen_and_logistics.fuel_rule: Advance is limited by tanker geometry and recovery/egress fuel; no free high-speed loiter near Kwajalein.

movement_clock.state: With Central-Pacific operation warning HIGH, Combined Fleet orders the three operational first-line carriers to leave the Truk-centered visible operating area under EMCON and move into a broad west-Marshall holding zone. This is an advance-to-threat order, not carrier GO.

Force remains several hundred nautical miles west of the Kwajalein-Maloelap battle space, using weather, emission discipline and tanker separation. It is close enough to shorten a future response but not close enough for an immediate short-range strike on a transient US contact.

After confirmation of at least two US carrier groups plus an assault force, the holding force edges east while preserving an exit to Truk/Palau. It does not rush into a 250-nmi launch point without a fresh mission-split contact.

required: known or strongly inferred US mission-state split
launch/recovery range compatible with escort fuel
other US carrier groups not positioned for an immediate overwhelming counterstrike
not_sufficient: one old carrier visual with >100-min age
